name: r3_recursive_seq_add_inv_bounds
informal: Classic: for a_0 = 1, a_{n+1} = a_n + 1/a_n one has 14 < a_100 < 15. Proof idea: a_n > 0 and a_{n+1}^2 = a_n^2 + 2 + 1/a_n^2, so by induction a_n^2 ≥ 2n+1 (lower bound 201 > 196); feeding this back, a_n^2 ≤ 2n + 1 + Σ_{k<n} 1/(2k+1), and the sum for n = 100 must be bounded numerically (e.g. < 24) to get a_100^2 < 225.
